Software Name

  • CURIE: gmeow:SoftwareName
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SoftwareName
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

An appellation borne by a software project or product — a project name, product name, codename, or package name. Carries its own gmeow:nameLanguage and gmeow:nameScript so co-equal multilingual names are separate first-class objects.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Appellation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:SoftwareName as a specialized kind of gmeow:Appellation. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
